scope: Identical fixture and harness; sample distributions aggregate raw samples, never averages of percentiles. CPU wall includes rasterization/upload/driver backpressure; real complete wall includes software GPU completion and polling, not hardware FPS. Owned GPU bytes describe program allocations, not measured VRAM residency; heap is after disposal and requested GC. No simulation executes inside measured presentation loops.
